task.title: Which statements answer the sub-question, and is it fully answered?
task.description: For one sub-question, tick the statements that are relevant to it and say whether they answer it fully.

questions.text: Which statements are **relevant** to this sub-question (give part or all of its answer)?
questions.none_label: None of the statements is relevant

questions.text: Taken together, do the statements **fully answer** this sub-question?

instructions.summary: For one **sub-question**, tick the statements that are relevant to it and decide whether they **fully answer** it.
instructions.background: A question was split into sub-questions, and an answer to the question was split into short statements. We measure whether the answer is complete (every sub-question answered) and concise (no statements that answer nothing).

criteria.label: Relevant
criteria.text: The statement gives part or all of the answer to this sub-question. Background that does not answer it is not relevant.

criteria.label: Covered
criteria.text: The relevant statements together fully answer the sub-question.

criteria.label: Not covered
criteria.text: A key piece of the answer is missing, or no statement is relevant.

steps: Read the original question and the sub-question.
Tick every relevant statement, or **None of the statements is relevant**.
notes: Judge from the statements only; do not check whether they are true.
instructions.tip: A sub-question can be Not covered even if some statements are relevant.

planner_notes: One item is one entry of decomposed_query shown with all statements of the answer; relevance labels are lists of selected statement keys, so the hint checks membership of target_key.
